title: A Formula 1 Crew Changed Four Tyres in 1.8 Seconds

scenes.text: A Formula 1 crew changed four tyres in 1.8 seconds.
It happened in Qatar in 2023. McLaren's crew serviced Lando Norris's car.
That broke the old record of 1.82 seconds, set by Red Bull in 2019.
Less than two seconds. Four wheels off. Four wheels on.
The race had a strict limit of 18 laps per tyre set, so McLaren had planned six stops.
1.8 seconds. Blink and you'd miss the record.

description:
In October 2023 at the Qatar Grand Prix, McLaren changed all four tyres on Lando Norris's car in 1.80 seconds, a new world record for an F1 pit stop.
It beat Red Bull's 1.82 seconds from 2019. Tyre wear limits that weekend meant teams planned many stops.
Could your crew beat the clock?
first_comment: What do you think you could do in 1.8 seconds? Tie a shoe? Send a text? Be honest.
